theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_bsb_besicovitch_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (A O : Set (Euclidean N)) (R : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ ≤ R ∧ closedBall x σ ⊆ O ∧ μ (closedBall x σ) ≤ t * ν (closedBall x σ)) → μ A ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * t * ν O
